implemented: Agent controls: new 'If the service is down' row opening Owner control; control cards now come from the shared components/ControlCard.tsx (same layout); the owner-transfer caption now says the pause applies once the transfer is confirmed

Owner control: what it needs (agent wallet, trusted manifest, trusted RPC, paused/epoch/owner nonces all unavailable; Mandate service and agent signer not needed); who pays the fee with three routes (Mandate relay, your personal account, someone else sends it), each naming the payer and its needs, all not available, and a note that no route works without a network and someone paying gas; from request to effect: prepared, signed not sent, sent waiting for confirmation, confirmed on chain (with the operation's own effect, not a blanket agent stop), failed on chain, expired (does not prove an earlier sent or relayed copy never ran); 'Before preparing a replacement' card: check inclusion, the current nonce for that command type and the authority epoch, which this build cannot read; owner operations Pause, Unpause, Revoke, Recover, Recover liquid and Sweep to owner, each with its effect on permissions and a 'Signed as' row (Admin command up to 30 minutes, or Owner transfer up to 10 minutes), all disabled; recovering several assets is a sequence; note that a sweep is an owner transfer to the owner address while a general owner transfer goes to the recipient the owner reviews and signs; signed command for another sender as two separate cards: Admin command (30 minutes, adminNonce, signed fields command, permitId, nonce, issuedAt, deadline; export schemaVersion, chainId, wallet, admin, ownerSignature, digest) and Owner transfer (10 minutes, ownerTransferNonce, signed fields transferId, asset, recipient, amount, epoch, nonce, issuedAt, deadline; export format not yet defined in the shared interface), both exports disabled, never words or keys, nothing uploaded automatically; labelled development sample sequence with no confirmed step; link to Recovery

Recovery and backup: 1. restore your wallet on a phone: recovery words, optional passphrase (a different passphrase opens a different wallet), account number 0-19; entered only on a protected native screen; after a restore the first five addresses are checked and an empty first address proves nothing; no server or cloud copy; Restore and Show recovery words disabled; no text fields. 2. recover agent wallet funds: restoring the key restores control but moves nothing and stops nothing; each owner command described with its own effect (Pause stops agents; Recover, Recover liquid and a sweep to owner bring funds to the owner address and each also pauses agents; Unpause stops nothing; counts only once confirmed); link to Owner control labelled 'Pause, recover and sweep to owner'. What does not stop agents: Log out and Remove wallet from this phone, each tagged 'Does not stop agents'; Remove disabled

corrections.requestedBy: Person3 owner review of the first UI-09 captures
items: Admin and OwnerTransfer are separate signed types: Admin up to 30 minutes with adminNonce, OwnerTransfer up to 10 minutes with ownerTransferNonce; each shows its own typed fields; the Admin export field list is not shown as the OwnerTransfer export (that format is not yet defined in the shared interface). Values tested against @mandate/schema authorityTypes, MAX_ADMIN_SECONDS and MAX_OWNER_TRANSFER_SECONDS.

Recovery uses 'Sweep to owner' (an owner transfer whose signed recipient is the owner address); a general owner transfer is described with the recipient the owner reviews and signs, not as owner-only.

Expiry does not prove an earlier sent or independently relayed copy never ran; reconcile inclusion, the current nonce and the epoch before a replacement. Step texts no longer imply that every command stops agents; each operation states its own confirmed effect.
